CommunityApplications.Profile: FejesNAS utilities for Unraid 7. Fejes Mover Monitor offers Hungarian, US English and German Mover/cache monitoring and optional guarded native movement in the reviewed setup. Version 2026.11.17.1 adds completed-download movement followed by resumed seeding, configurable cache fill start/stop limits (default 75% / 65%), and one complete unit per run up to 32 GiB and 128 files. Fresh isolated peer, hybrid-placement and installed-scheduler acceptance passed on Unraid 7.3.4. Observer remains the default; installation enables no movement or new schedule. Oversized/incomplete torrents stay in cache. Power-loss recovery and compatibility limits are documented on GitHub.
